description_en: Assigns users to multiple cloud computers in a batch
description_zh: 批量分配用户到多台云电脑
kebab_example: aliyun ecd batch-modify-entitlement --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --max-user-per-desktop 1 --max-desktop-per-user 0 --strategy AVERAGE --desktop-id ecd-gx2x1dhsmucyy0000 --end-user-id Alice --preview true --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchModifyEntitlement

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call DescribeRegions to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service (EDS)
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用DescribeRegions获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of users to assign to each cloud computer
parameters.help_zh: 每台云电脑分配用户数量
parameters.name: max_user_per_desktop

parameters.help_en: The number of cloud computers to assign to each user
parameters.help_zh: 每个用户分配云电脑数量
parameters.name: max_desktop_per_user

parameters.help_en:
The policy used when the ratio of cloud computers to users cannot be evenly matched. Valid values:

AVERAGE: Prioritizes assigning a cloud computer to each user. When the number of selected cloud computers and users cannot be evenly matched, the system prioritizes assigning a cloud computer to each user.

CENTRAL: Prioritizes assigning the specified number of cloud computers to users. When the number of selected cloud computers and users cannot be evenly matched, the system prioritizes assigning the specified number of cloud computers to users
parameters.help_zh:
无法按比例匹配策略：

AVERAGE：优先给每个用户分配云电脑，当所选云电脑数与用户数无法按比例匹配时，优先给每个用户分配云电脑。

CENTRAL：优先给用户分配指定数量的云电脑，当所选云电脑数与用户数无法按比例匹配时，优先给用户分配指定数量的云电脑
parameters.name: strategy

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the cloud computers for which you want to update authorized users
parameters.help_zh: 要修改授权用户的云电脑ID列表
parameters.name: desktop_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to preview the assignment. If you set this parameter to true, the assignment is not actually performed
parameters.help_zh: 是否预览，预览不会真正分配
parameters.name: preview
